## Glossary

_Terms used by **2026bp** (The Label Moves the Reading: Entity-Name Leakage in Language-Model Dimensional Ratings of a Fixed Text). Defined terms this paper introduces, refines, or imports from the corpus ontology._

*Terms introduced by this paper*

- **Byte-identical name exchange** (write: `byte-identical name exchange`)
  - A manipulation in which an entity name occupying a single slot in an artifact is replaced by another name of matched type while every other byte of the artifact is unchanged, so that any movement in a reading taken over the artifact is attributable to the label alone; substitution rather than removal, because an ablated identifier leaves the entity in the residual content and makes the artifact incongruous.
  - first use: Method — The contrast
- **Entity-name leakage** (write: `entity-name leakage`)
  - The share of a language model's dimensional rating of a written artifact that is carried by the name of the entity the artifact is said to concern rather than by the artifact's content; measured as the movement in the rated profile when the entity name is exchanged and the artifact text is held byte-identical.
  - first use: Abstract; Background
- **Residual-referenced neutrality guard** (write: `residual-referenced guard`)
  - A neutrality test that refers a text-by-entity interaction to the within-cell residual rather than to the entity main effect, on the ground that the main effect moves with replicate count and with its own magnitude while the interaction it is meant to calibrate does not, so that a main-effect-referenced ratio has no stable null to be judged against.
  - first use: Results — What the guard was measuring; Discussion
- **Test-retest yardstick** (write: `test-retest yardstick`)
  - The spread of one operator's readings over repeat presentations of an identical prompt, used as the reference against which a manipulation's effect is judged large or small; an effect above one yardstick unit moves the reading further than re-asking the same question moves it.
  - first use: Method — The magnitude and its yardstick

*Imported terms (defined elsewhere)*

- **perception cloud**
  - The distribution of brand convictions across an observer population for a brand. Distributional, not a single fixed referent; "cloud" alone is acceptable in context. Has a valence (positive / negative / ambivalent).
  - _defined by 2026a_
  - _not_: brand image; brand cloud
- **Reflection (per-artifact spectral measurement)** (write: `reflection`)
  - The unit of measurement in the Brand Spectrometer: the brand signal as reflected through a single public artifact and read by one operator pair, yielding one eight-dimensional spec vector bound to one source. It is the data-of-record the instrument aggregates reflection -> source -> cohort, recomputable into cohorts at any resolution. The optics-native name is deliberate: a spectrometer measures reflected signal, and perception is completed in the observer (the brand 'has no colour' until reflected and read). Distinct from the atom-cloud-fact 'atom' (2026b), a single (dimension, source) cell of raw observation; a reflection bundles all eight dimensions from one source and is operator-produced, so it is not a refinement of that atom and does not edit it.
  - _defined by 2026ax_
